senses.gloss: उज्-√ जन् (उद्-√ जन्), only, RV. : P. (pf. -जजा॑न, iii, 1, 12) to beget, produce : Ā. (impf. 3. pl. उद्-अ॑जायन्त, iv, 18, 1; aor. -अ॑जनि, i, 74, 3; precative of the aor. -जनिषीष्ट, vii, 8, 6) to be born or produced, originate.
उज्-जयन m. N. of a man, MBh.
उज्-√ जस् (उद्-√ जस्), Caus. P. -जासयति, to destroy, extirpate, kill (with gen. Pāṇ. ii, 3, 56), Bhaṭṭ.; Śiś.
उज्-जानक m. N. of a Tīrtha, MBh.; Hariv.
उज्जालुक m. N. of a place, MBh.
उज्-जयनी f. Ujjayinī (see below) or Oujein.
उज्-जयन्त m. N. of a mountain in Surāṣṭra (in the west of India, part of the Vindhya range), MBh.

उज्-जयिनी f. the city Oujein (the Gk. Ὀζήνη, a city so called in Avanti or Mālava, formerly the capital of Vikramāditya; it is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindūs, and the first meridian of their geographers, from which they calculate longitude; the modern Oujein is about a mile south of the ancient city), Hit.; Megh.; Rājat. &c.
